paper_title: An Approximate Kernel for Connected Feedback Vertex Set
statement: For instance, is there a space efficient PSAKS for Connected Feedback Vertex Set? In a space efficient PSAKS, we require the size of the output to be bounded by f ( 1ε ) · k c , where f is a computable function and c is a constant independent of the error parameter ε. Essentially, a PSAKS is an apt analogue of a PTAS in the approximate kernelization world and an Efficient PSAKS is a natural analogues of an Efficient PTAS in this setting. We end by pointing out that the existence of a space efficient PSAKS is open even in the case of the Connected Vertex Cover problem.
context: Our result on approximate kernelization for Connected Feedback Vertex Set provides another useful data point in improving our understanding of the extent to which (approximate) preprocessing can be performed in the presence of connectivity constraints. Moreover, we believe that our techniques could have further applications in the design of approximate kernels for covering problems with connectivity constraints.
